svg.title: AWS Shield Standard compared with AWS Shield Advanced
svg.desc: Two panels. Left: AWS Shield Standard. No additional charge and nothing to turn on: every AWS customer has it. It defends against the most common network and transport layer attacks, such as SYN floods and UDP reflection. It is strongest for CloudFront, Route 53 hosted zones and Global Accelerator. It has no people to call, no bill protection and no web-request (layer 7) mitigation. Right, highlighted: AWS Shield Advanced. $3,000 a month with a 1-year subscription, billed once per organization's payer account, plus data transfer fees. You choose the resources to protect: CloudFront, Route 53 hosted zones, load balancers, Elastic IP addresses and Global Accelerator. It adds automatic web-request (layer 7) mitigation through AWS WAF and covers standard WAF fees on those resources. It brings the Shield Response Team, DDoS experts available around the clock, and AWS's page also requires a Business or Enterprise Support plan for them. It adds DDoS cost protection: credits for scaling charges an attack causes. Note: Support plans change on 2027-01-01, when Business Support ends; AWS's SRT page still named it on 2026-10-24.
svg.text: Shield Standard comes with your account; Shield Advanced is a decision
What each tier gives you, as AWS described it when we checked
AWS Shield Standard
• No additional charge, and nothing to turn
on: every AWS customer has it
• Defends against the most common network and
transport layer attacks, such as SYN floods
and UDP reflection
• Strongest for CloudFront, Route 53 hosted
zones and Global Accelerator
• No people to call, no bill protection, no
web-request (layer 7) mitigation
AWS Shield Advanced
• $3,000 a month with a 1-year subscription,
billed once per organization's payer
account, plus data transfer fees
• You choose the resources: CloudFront, Route
53 hosted zones, load balancers, Elastic IP
addresses, Global Accelerator
• Adds automatic web-request (layer 7)
mitigation through AWS WAF, and covers
standard WAF fees on those resources
• Shield Response Team (SRT): DDoS experts,
around the clock; AWS's page also requires a
Business or Enterprise Support plan
• DDoS cost protection: credits for scaling
charges an attack causes
Support plans change on 2027-01-01, when Business Support ends; AWS's SRT page still named it on 2026-10-24.
From the AWS Shield developer guide, Shield FAQ and Shield pricing page, checked 2026-10-24. Prices change.
